probes.check: After the engine, context and log are gone, the facade's probe-build block tracking shows miniaudio released no block the facade didn't allocate; one it did fails the rule as ALLOC_HOOK_LATE(miniaudio).

seeded_violation.description: Allocate a block with miniaudio's default allocator before filling in the callbacks, then free it through the facade's.

probes.check: am_probe_miniaudio_allocation(): the engine and its context hold the facade's callbacks, and the facade served miniaudio during the run.

seeded_violation.description: Leave the callbacks empty in am_bind_miniaudio_allocation(), so miniaudio uses the C runtime's allocator.

adaptation_notes: miniaudio copies ma_allocation_callbacks out of each object's config (ma_log_init, ma_context_config, ma_engine_config) when the object is made: the binding fills the callbacks setup glue hands to all three in the memory phase, before any of them exists.
miniaudio asks for no particular alignment; its callbacks map to the facade's allocate, reallocate and release.
